item.title: Version 1.0.15
item.description:
Bug fix: Sparkle update prompt was throwing "An error occurred while parsing the update feed" because the appcast XML had a duplicate length= attribute.  Cleaned up the build script so future appcasts come out valid.

New: in-app update banner.  When a new version of Flipped is available, you'll see a yellow strip at the top of the window with the version number, "what's new" expandable section, and an UPDATE NOW button.  No more relying on the Check for Updates… menu — you can't miss it now.
